{"id": "17182599-e82f-4b78-841c-2f8474a11ece", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "**Result:** `llmops-lf-agent-ondemand` is the only other resource calling Bedrock the same broken way. Nothing else in the account is configured with a bare model ID that lacks on-demand support.

| Resource | Model ID | Bare or profile | Status | Recommended replacement |

| AgentCore runtime `llmops_eval_billing_agent` | `us.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0` | profile | OK | none needed |
| ~13 Lambdas (all `llmops-lf-gr-*-app`, `llmops-lf-aip-app`, `llmops-lf-catalog-tagger`) | `us.amazon.nova-lite-v1:0` | profile | OK | none needed |
